title: athyrium filix-femina var. molle
intro: Athyrium filix-femina var. molle, commonly known as Lady's fern, is a variety of the female fern that is native to Europe and Asia. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to soothe skin irritations and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of Lady's fern are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Lady's fern include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
